features.name: total_insurance_policies
features.description: Sum of all policy counts across different insurance types.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a continuous measure of overall customer engagement and insurance footprint, useful for linear scaling.
features.formula: numberOfPrivateThirdPartyInsurance + numberOfThirdPartyInsuranceFirms + numberOfThirdPartyInsuranceAgriculture + numberOfCarPolicies + numberOfDeliveryVanPolicies + numberOfMotorcycleScooterPolicies + numberOfLorryPolicies + numberOfTrailerPolicies + numberOfTractorPolicies + numberOfAgriculturalMachinesPolicies + numberOfMopedPolicies + numberOfLifeInsurances + numberOfPrivateAccidentInsurancePolicies + numberOfFamilyAccidentsInsurancePolicies + numberOfDisabilityInsurancePolicies + numberOfFirePolicies + numberOfSurfboardPolicies + numberOfBoatPolicies + numberOfBicyclePolicies + numberOfPropertyInsurancePolicies + numberOfSocialSecurityInsurancePolicies

features.name: car_policy_ratio
features.description: Ratio of car policies to total policies, indicating focus on auto insurance.
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes car policy count against total engagement, creating a smooth bounded feature ideal for SVM margins.
features.formula: numberOfCarPolicies / np.maximum(1, numberOfPrivateThirdPartyInsurance + numberOfThirdPartyInsuranceFirms + numberOfThirdPartyInsuranceAgriculture + numberOfCarPolicies + numberOfDeliveryVanPolicies + numberOfMotorcycleScooterPolicies + numberOfLorryPolicies + numberOfTrailerPolicies + numberOfTractorPolicies + numberOfAgriculturalMachinesPolicies + numberOfMopedPolicies + numberOfLifeInsurances + numberOfPrivateAccidentInsurancePolicies + numberOfFamilyAccidentsInsurancePolicies + numberOfDisabilityInsurancePolicies + numberOfFirePolicies + numberOfSurfboardPolicies + numberOfBoatPolicies + numberOfBicyclePolicies + numberOfPropertyInsurancePolicies + numberOfSocialSecurityInsurancePolicies)

features.name: fire_policy_ratio
features.description: Ratio of fire policies to total policies.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights customers whose primary insurance relationship is property/fire-related.
features.formula: numberOfFirePolicies / np.maximum(1, numberOfPrivateThirdPartyInsurance + numberOfThirdPartyInsuranceFirms + numberOfThirdPartyInsuranceAgriculture + numberOfCarPolicies + numberOfDeliveryVanPolicies + numberOfMotorcycleScooterPolicies + numberOfLorryPolicies + numberOfTrailerPolicies + numberOfTractorPolicies + numberOfAgriculturalMachinesPolicies + numberOfMopedPolicies + numberOfLifeInsurances + numberOfPrivateAccidentInsurancePolicies + numberOfFamilyAccidentsInsurancePolicies + numberOfDisabilityInsurancePolicies + numberOfFirePolicies + numberOfSurfboardPolicies + numberOfBoatPolicies + numberOfBicyclePolicies + numberOfPropertyInsurancePolicies + numberOfSocialSecurityInsurancePolicies)

features.name: high_income_indicator
features.description: Composite score of higher income brackets.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates sparse high-income categories into a single continuous severity measure.

features.name: family_size_density
features.description: Ratio of average household size to number of houses.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures living density, providing a continuous projection of household structure.

features.name: social_class_ab_composite
features.description: Sum of social class A, B1, and B2 indicators.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a linear projection of upper/middle social class standing.

features.name: home_ownership_margin
features.description: Difference between home owners and rented house indicators.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a signed continuous margin representing the tilt towards home ownership vs renting.

features.name: vehicle_ownership_score
features.expected_model_benefit: Linearly scales vehicle ownership severity, penalizing no car and rewarding multiple cars.

features.name: education_level_index
features.expected_model_benefit: Projects categorical-like ordinal education data onto a continuous linear axis.

features.name: life_stage_stability_judgment
features.description: Semantic assessment of life stability based on customerMainType, customerSubtype, and avgAge.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures non-linear interactions between age, family type, and social status that indicate settled lifestyles.

features.name: insurance_purchasing_power_alignment
features.description: Semantic evaluation of whether the customer's purchasingPowerClass aligns with their current insurance portfolio complexity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Identifies under-insured or over-insured profiles relative to their means, useful for margin separation.

features.name: rural_vs_urban_lifestyle_tilt
features.description: Semantic judgment of rural/agricultural lifestyle vs urban lifestyle based on occupation (farmer), vehicle types (tractor, moped), and customer subtypes.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a continuous geographic/lifestyle projection that linear models can easily weight.
